notes.title: The demo of Exo Helljumper: Descent X is now available
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! [i][b]Exo Helljumper: Descent X[/b][/i] is now officially available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330822/9abcee358ba5353e90f29d51aba0706e3d978ce6.jpg[/img]

Exo Helljumper: Descent X is a dungeon-shooting game. Players will play as cyborg agents and bravely break into dungeons. By combining different prosthetics and props, they can create personalized combat strategies. Every battle in the game is full of unknowns and challenges. From the diverse combination of weapons to the rich changes in enemy types, it can bring a unique new way of playing.

In the Demo version, players can control 3 characters with different abilities and use dozens of prosthetics with different performances to explore their own unique way of passing the level. There are 3 weapons in the game for players to choose from. The same prosthetic will also collide with completely different sparks on different weapons!
The Demo version contains a complete level with 8 rooms and 1 boss. Each room in the level will be randomly selected from dozens of rooms, and each game will bring a new experience to players!

[h2]Play it for free now! Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282130/_/
